capabilities: Display links up to two hops away as cards
Preview the content of each linked note
Open links from a context menu, e.g. in new tabs
Sort links and exclude configured paths
Show the cards in a separate pane
extras: The README lists the added features over the upstream fork but gives no usage instructions or screenshots.
intentEvidence: This plugin is a fork of tokuhirom/obsidian-2hop-links-plugin and extends its functionality.
motivation: The author forked the original 2hop-links plugin to add features such as automatic box width adjustment, better previews, and exclusion paths.
problem: Obsidian's backlinks and outgoing links only show one hop, making it hard to browse connections between notes that are two steps apart.

relations.evidence: This plugin is a fork of tokuhirom/obsidian-2hop-links-plugin

summary: Link browser that displays links up to two hops away as cards with note previews.
